$comment: Conformance fixtures for the RLTP publication checks. Each base document MUST pass its schema; each case mutates a base ('set' writes a JSON Pointer, 'delete' removes one) and MUST be rejected. The philosophy follows the ToIP DTGWG registry: a checker that has never been shown to fail is not evidence of anything. Cases are drawn from the specifications' vector plans.

cases.name: credential root closed: validUntil is structurally impossible (never revoked, never expires)
credential root closed: credentialStatus rejected
legacy DTG type stamp rejected (RLTP-owned type, exactly two entries)
pinned contexts: a third context is rejected
challenge below the 22-char entropy floor (UUID-v4-class values fail)
stale credential format version rejected
closed subject: smuggled peerChallenge rejected
raw digest without multihash header rejected (43-char legacy form)
calendar-syntax gate: leap second is excluded from the profile
wrong cryptosuite rejected
card version drift rejected
raw unprefixed key-agreement key rejected (Multikey required)
challenge without issuance time rejected
envelope without recipient key identifier rejected
tag-only ciphertext rejected (below 23-char minimum)
non-canonical base64url ciphertext length rejected (mod 4 = 1)
wrong nonce length rejected
ack meaning is a closed one-value set
ack ref must carry the multihash header
expiresAt is forbidden on delivery documents (delivery time is unbounded)
reserved public task namespace rejected (private types only)
threadId must be a UUID
sentTo without boundTo rejected (co-presence, dependentRequired)
boundTo without sentTo rejected (co-presence, dependentRequired)
boundTo below the 22-char entropy floor rejected
genesis: a group is founded by exactly one person, never by a list
genesis: the founder's contact card is required — keys must have somewhere to be sealed
genesis: epoch is 0 by definition
genesis: the root operation has no ancestors
genesis: the adapter that produced epoch 0 must be named
envelope: unknown fields inside a closed body profile are rejected (only the envelope root is open)
envelope: a proof without signatures proves nothing
transition: under rltp-access/0.25 historyNarrow is withdrawn — history is never narrowed (RLTP-ACC-9810, OI-19)
transition: under rltp-access/0.25 historyNarrow is rejected even beside a lineage (RLTP-ACC-9810)
transition: a linear/0.1 transition must carry lineage or, on a discharge only, a declared void (RLTP-ACC-9810)
transition: a ciphertext too short to hold key, nonce and tag is not one
transition: keyDist entries are closed — no room for an unbound extra field
view: a quorum of zero would authenticate nothing
view: only the seq-0 view may have no predecessor
view: the seq-0 view must have no predecessor
view: an empty identity set authorizes nobody and cannot carry a quorum
view: the same signature twice is one signature
material: the adapter that owns the key shape must be named
material: linear/0.1 carries exactly the content key — everything else is derived, never transported
material: a content key that is not 32 bytes is not a content key
genesis: the key operation of epoch 0 is bound by keyOpDigest (Access 9.2, 3260)
genesis: under linear/0.1 the epoch-0 binding is contentKeyCommitment (Access 4.5, 9.4.1)
genesis: only a registered adapter can be named (Access 3255, 11)

transition: keyOpDigest is a multibase multihash
transition: a linear/0.1 transition without keyDist reaches nobody (Access 9.4.1)
transition: lineageForm no longer exists — the history disposition is the adapter's (Access 9.4.1)
transition: the bare form carries no linear/0.1 field — a half-linear transition is no form
device.add: the device card carries exactly its five fields (Access 5110)
device.add: a device card without key-agreement key has nowhere to receive keys
device.add: an unsigned device card binds nothing (Access 5120)
device.add: additive — it carries no transition (Access 4.5)
device.revoke: an enforcement — the transition travels in the same envelope (Access 4440, 5160)
device.revoke: the device is named by the digest of its card, not by its key
device.revoke: the device's person is named
registration: class is required — no default service class (Access 7230, 7330, 9560)
registration: the service class is one of blind, view, log
registration: the 0.26 form has no class and is superseded (Access 11)
material: beekem/0.1 keys are closed — no linear/0.1 content key beside the key operation
material: only a registered adapter owns a key shape (Access 11)
key-delivery: an unregistered kind is rejected (RLTP-ACC-10040, 11050)
key-delivery: the beekem/0.1 material kind needs its sealed material (RLTP-ACC-9897, 10050)
transition: under rltp-access/0.25 a transition names the key states it succeeds — without succeeds no healing need can end (RLTP-ACC-7045, 9872, 9865)
transition: an empty succeeds succeeds nothing — at least one key state (RLTP-ACC-7045)
transition: succeeds names at most 64 key states — more open states heal in steps (RLTP-ACC-7045, 9762)

transition: succeeds names key states by identifier, never by epoch number (RLTP-ACC-7042, 9262)

envelope: an rltp-access/0.24 genesis is rejected (RLTP-ACC-11100)

lineage.repair: the edge needs the transition it belongs to (RLTP-ACC-9830)

key request: a request seals nothing (RLTP-ACC-10050)
registration: the intake budget is a block { operations, bytes }, not a bare number (RLTP-ACC-9535)
registration: a declared intake budget counts bytes as well as operations (RLTP-ACC-9535)
registration: a declared intake budget is positive (RLTP-ACC-9535)

key-delivery: a request names the claiming anchor in subject (RLTP-ACC-10105)
key-delivery: subject is a member anchor did:key, not an operation (RLTP-ACC-10105)

issuerScope is required at the credential root (RLTP-ENC-7010, DTG WD 0.6.0 Base Structure)
